themes_detail.label: Street Deterioration Surge
themes_detail.summary: Street condition complaints spiked to 182 THIS WEEK, a 236% increase from the 8-week average of 54.2 per week (z-score: 5.36), suggesting rapid pavement or infrastructure failure across CD413 that requires immediate DOT assessment.
evidence: 182 street condition complaints THIS WEEK vs. 54.2 weekly baseline over prior 8 weeks (236% spike, z-score 5.36)
Street reconstruction is a repeated budget request from Community Board, indicating chronic underinvestment
DOT has authority to conduct immediate pavement and infrastructure inspections
reporting_angles: What specific streets are failing? Map the complaints and conduct visual survey of worst-hit corridors.
Has DOT received emergency work orders, or are repairs backlogged? Interview DOT to determine response timeline.

themes_detail.label: Flooring/Stairs Complaints Explode
themes_detail.summary: Flooring and stairs complaints surged to 11 LAST WEEK, a 529% increase from the 8-week average of 1.8 per week (z-score: 7.72, highest severity), pointing to possible building code violations or deteriorating residential/public structures.
evidence: 11 flooring/stairs complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.8 weekly baseline over prior 8 weeks (529% spike, highest z-score at 7.72)
648 DOB alteration permits filed in last 90 days, including 72 alteration COs, suggesting ongoing construction or repair work
Community Board has repeated requests to expand code enforcement (Department of Buildings), indicating enforcement gaps
reporting_angles: Interview DOB to determine which buildings triggered complaints and whether violations notices were issued.
Speak with residents in buildings with flooring/stair complaints about safety concerns and repair timelines.

themes_detail.label: Unsanitary Conditions Rise
themes_detail.summary: Unsanitary condition complaints jumped to 35 LAST WEEK, a 204% increase from the 8-week average of 11.5 per week (z-score: 5.32), coinciding with elevated dead animal and obstruction complaints, suggesting sanitation and pest management problems.
evidence: 35 unsanitary condition complaints LAST WEEK vs. 11.5 weekly baseline over prior 8 weeks (204% spike, z-score 5.32)
Dead animal complaints spiked to 16 TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 3.8 weekly baseline (327% spike, z-score 5.82)
Obstruction complaints at 34 TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 12.4 weekly baseline (175% spike, z-score 5.45) suggest blocked streets/alleys trapping waste
reporting_angles: Is DSNY reducing collection frequency or facing staffing shortages in this district? Check service schedules.
Are dead animals accumulating due to pest infestation? Interview Sanitation and pest control officials.

themes_detail.label: Water Infrastructure Failures
themes_detail.summary: Water leak complaints jumped to 14 LAST WEEK, a 261% increase from the 8-week average of 3.9 per week (z-score: 4.28), while water system complaints remain the 5th highest volume issue at 868 over 90 days, signaling infrastructure stress.
evidence: 14 water leak complaints LAST WEEK vs. 3.9 weekly baseline over prior 8 weeks (261% spike, z-score 4.28)
Water system complaints are 5th highest volume issue across all complaint types (868 over 90 days)
Heat/hot water complaints at 626 over 90 days suggest intertwined building system failures
reporting_angles: Interview DEP about main break activity and water quality alerts in this district over the past 2 weeks.
Check if water leak spikes correlate with recent weather events (freeze-thaw cycles) or aging infrastructure.

themes_detail.label: Overgrown Trees Obstruct Streets
themes_detail.summary: Overgrown tree and branch complaints rose to 12 THIS WEEK, a 174% increase from the 8-week average of 4.4 per week (z-score: 4.24), overlapping with street obstruction and condition spikes, suggesting Parks maintenance backlog.
evidence: 12 overgrown tree/branch complaints THIS WEEK vs. 4.4 weekly baseline over prior 8 weeks (174% spike, z-score 4.24)
Converges with street condition spike (182 complaints this week) and obstruction spike (34 complaints 2 weeks ago)
Community Board repeatedly requests better park maintenance and park amenity upgrades, indicating chronic underinvestment
reporting_angles: Has Parks Department been notified? What is the timeline for tree trimming in this district?
Are overgrown branches actually blocking sidewalks or roads, creating safety hazards? Document with photos.
